# BraDypUS

> BraDypUS is free, self-hosted software (AGPL-3.0) for managing relational data in
> the humanities and cultural heritage: archaeology, museums, archives, bibliographies.
> You define tables, fields, vocabularies and relations; it provides forms, search,
> import/export, users/groups/permissions, record versions, files, maps and print
> templates. PHP API + Vue app, on SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL, from Docker images.
> Current major version: v5.

Start here to judge whether a dataset is worth moving into BraDypUS, then go deeper
only as far as the task needs.

## Level 1 — decide

- [Is BraDypUS right for your data?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/evaluate.md): fit checklist, what the data must look like, how much work a migration is (Markdown, ~5 KB)

## Level 2 — build

- [DBML import/export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/dbml.md): describe a whole schema as text and import it in one step
- [Import data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/usage/import.md): CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and photo imports, with key-field upsert
- [Creating an application](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/create-app/index.md): web form or command line
- [Field types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/adding-columns.md), [relations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/relations.md), [vocabularies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/vocabularies.md)
- [Groups, permissions & locks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/groups.md): who sees and changes which rows; freezing published records
- [SQL views as tables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/setup/views.md): hidden columns, rows per role and draft → review → validated flows are obtained with SQL views plus triggers, not with the permission screens (MariaDB/MySQL; views are dropped on SQLite)
- Ready-made skill that starts a new application from existing data with an assistant: [skills/bradypus-bootstrap/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/skills/bradypus-bootstrap/SKILL.md); installable archive: [bradypus-bootstrap.zip](https://docs.bdus.lad-sapienza.it/bradypus-bootstrap.zip)

## Level 3 — reference

- [User guide (HTML)](https://docs.bdus.lad-sapienza.it/guide/): every feature, with screenshots
- [System plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-docs/guide/system-plugins/index.md): geodata, Harris matrix, fuzzy dates, radiocarbon, osteology, Zotero, Pleiades
- [REST API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/bdus-api/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3 contract (the same endpoints the app uses)
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.bdus.lad-sapienza.it/dev/): architecture, database, record lifecycle
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS/v5/CHANGELOG.md)
- Source: https://github.com/lad-sapienza/BraDypUS
